## Description
Briefly describe the change and the rationale behind it.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to break)
- [ ] Refactor / Code Quality improvement
- [ ] CI/CD or Docker infrastructure enhancement
- [ ] Documentation update

## Testing & Verification
- [ ] Backend tests passing (`manage.py test`)
- [ ] Frontend builds without errors (`npm run build`)
- [ ] Docker Compose builds and starts cleanly (`docker compose up --build`)
- [ ] Healthcheck endpoints respond with HTTP 200 (`/api/health/` and `/healthz`)

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the style guidelines of this project
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have commented my code in complex areas
- [ ] Corresponding documentation has been updated
